description: Strict contract for human-curated SFT examples

required_fields.question_type: ONE OF: factual, explanatory, comparative, applied, abstention
required_fields.tradition: ONE OF: SVETAMBARA, DIGAMBARA, MULTI_TRADITION, CROSS_TRADITION
required_fields.lineage: ONE OF: STHANAKAVASI, MURTIPOJAK, TERAPANTH, GENERIC, UNKNOWN
required_fields.knowledge_layer: ONE OF: CANONICAL, COMMENTARY, TEACHING, PRACTICE, TERMINOLOGY, HISTORY, CROSS_TRADITION, UNKNOWN
required_fields.content_role: ONE OF: ORIGINAL_TEXT, TRANSLATION, COMMENTARY, TEACHING, PRACTICE_EXPLANATION, HISTORY, UNKNOWN
required_fields.teacher: Teacher name if attributed, empty otherwise
required_fields.agam_id: Agam ID if applicable, empty otherwise
required_fields.practice: Practice name if applicable, empty otherwise
required_fields.verification_status: ONE OF: SOURCE_GROUNDED, SOURCE_GROUNDED_MULTI_SOURCE, ABSTENTION_REQUIRED, REVIEW_REQUIRED, REJECTED
required_fields.reviewer_status: ONE OF: PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED, REVISION_REQUIRED

verification_status_definitions.SOURCE_GROUNDED: All factual claims traceable to a single source
verification_status_definitions.SOURCE_GROUNDED_MULTI_SOURCE: All factual claims traceable to multiple sources
verification_status_definitions.ABSTENTION_REQUIRED: Source does not contain answer, model should abstain

quality_requirements: Every factual claim must be traceable to one or more source units
No facts added from model memory
Source disagreements must be represented and attributed
Evidence-based abstention when source does not answer
Teacher attribution must be supported by provenance
Generic Jain material cannot become Sthanakavasi through wording
Questions must not contain answer-trivializing information
